note: Single source of truth for built-in source presets. schema:1 + sources is also the runtime remote-update payload fetched by src/lib/remotesources.js. ARRAY ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT: it drives panel dropdown order and best-mode tie-breaking. For subscription sources, nameIncludes pattern values ARE the per-model prices users see (monthlyFee / per-model monthly allowance); manualRatio is only the fallback for rule-less pattern entries. Patterns must be ordered most-specific first - scripts/build-sources.js fails on shadowed or duplicate patterns. src/data/sources.js is generated from this file (node scripts/build-sources.js); builtin:true is injected at build time, never hand-written here.

Source: https://modeldial.com/subscriptions ; MiniMax column "国内 · Go". CNY 49/month; USD monthlyFee 7.298944 uses this page's stated USD1 = CNY6.7133 (review-date conversion, not a live FX quote). Displayed approximate API-equivalent USD: MiniMax M3.1 Flash $21/week. Each model ratio = USD monthlyFee / its monthly equivalent, rounded to six decimals; displayed USD values are used without inferring additional precision from token counts. Domestic and international Go/Explore/Build columns are distinct; do not scale one region from another. Published per-week API-equivalent estimates are converted by 52/12. Five-hour limits can constrain realized use. The Preview variant has no published plan allowance and is excluded; this guard is intentionally zero-hit while AA lacks that variant. No allowance is inferred for MiniMax M3 or earlier models. Full usable quota assumed; shared model allowances cannot be added. Workload, caching and short-window limits affect realized value; these are not official USD balances.
